s1.note: Sector 1 engagement: a Voidsworn destroyer and two frigates (torpedoes, a turret, autocannons, flak) against a Hegemony destroyer and two pickets (plasma lasers and turbolasers), shields, ship deaths

s2.note: Sector 1 flagship fight: the Hegemony flagship and two escorts against a Voidsworn cruiser, destroyer and two frigates (batteries, lance, torpedoes, turret, autocannons, flak); boss scaling, boss Command, escorts breaking, wrecks left as terrain

s3.note: Sector 1 engagement in an asteroid belt: Corsair marauder, reaver and raider (rocket salvos that point defense can shoot down, scrap guns, overburn, ramming AI) against a Voidsworn cruiser and two frigates

s4.note: Timing test, sector 3 size: 10 Voidsworn ships against 10 Hegemony ships, veteran AI (carriers left out: squadrons are not ported yet)

s5.note: Timing test, sector 3 size: 10 Voidsworn ships against 10 Corsair ships (ramming AI looks ahead from every hex), veteran AI

s6.note: Carriers: Ashgrove (Scramble Command, squadron damage) with a Reliquary carrier against a Corsair hulk-carrier fleet; opening wings, launches, bombers and the flak gauntlet, enemy wings, full bot (Command, abilities, rams, boarding, brace, turning in place); a campaign battle with a random mid-battle event

s7.note: Generated enemy fleet (carrier archetype, exact V8 pow in the budget) against two Voidsworn carriers: carrier adaptation (point-defence refits, B-20, and the adaptive fighter screen), Hegemony fighters, flank deployment; attack-move (fire during the burn) when no gun bears

s8.note: Boons, relics, aspect and heat: twelve boons at all three rarities, five relics, the bulwark aspect, veteran captains, Veteran escorts, Undying foes and Slow orders against an Ithar elite fleet (phase jumps, a wraithcarrier); Thale (Iron Command)

s9.note: Campaign battle with enemy reinforcements (forced event), generated heavy Deathless fleet with a bounty, the Standard AI, Hunted heat; Malek (Hunt Command) with the Ascendant (nova) in sector 3; more boons and relics

s10.note: Campaign battle with a solar flare (forced event), generated Chorus swarm fleet against the hive aspect (counts as a second carrier: spore refits), Vex (Barrage Command); the last twelve boons

s11.note: Fight type: Hold the station (defend). Station integrity, station batteries, the guard ring; Hegemony attackers with a carrier

s12.note: Fight type: Hunt. The running flagship deploys short of its escorts and jumps out after round 6; corridor field

s13.note: Fight type: Intercept. Transports cross to the far edge under escort (veteran escorts screen the convoy); Chorus spores

s14.note: Fight type: Breakthrough. Get half the fleet off the far edge past an Ithar blocking line (veterans block the lead ship's lane); attack-move (fire during the burn) when no gun bears

s15.note: Fight type: Relay (hold), Standard AI (the flat relay pull); Deathless on a dense field

s16.note: Fight type: Relay (hold), veteran AI (the two nearest enemy ships contest it, urgency); round or square arena with an angled approach

s17.note: Fight type: Ambush. Two enemy groups close in from both sides

s18.note: Fight type: Decapitation (flagship). Killing the flagship scatters the fleet

s19.note: Dead-star gravity well (owner ruling Oct 24): pulls, tidal damage and the AI steering around the well; a storm field, Deathless phasing ships

s20.note: Fight type: Engagement (rout) on a generated fleet, sector 1 column 0, the sector 1 opener (three ships, so the field stays open; s47 covers the compact field)

s21.note: Classic mode (whole turns, battle.js aiTurn: squadrons first, then each ship picked by opportunity) with the full bot; carriers on both sides; attack-move (fire during the burn) when no gun bears

s22.note: Classic mode with the Standard AI and the basic bot; Corsair raiders

s23.note: Timing: carrier-heavy 10 against 10 in sector 3 (three Reliquary carriers and Ashgrove against a Hegemony fleet with three launch hulls): the worst case for enemy think time, squadrons on both sides

s24.note: B-20 coverage: Ashgrove with three carriers against a generated Hegemony flagship fleet (point-defence refits that lack fired, cdLeft, off and their name; the flagship's Barrage Command resets and restores them; criticals can knock a refit out and bring it into the flak gauntlet); a campaign battle in a sector at war

s25.note: B-20 coverage, second fleet: Corsair player carriers and the hive aspect against a generated Hegemony carrier fleet (refits on most escorts, fighter screen), sector at war, Classic mode, faction ship names (FNAMES)

s26.note: Stream B step 1: Hegemony synchronized fire on both sides (anchors, the sync mark, losing the anchor), Hegemony ion locking shield regen, the drill verb (sync radius 4, +20%), class refit track

s27.note: Ithar prism charge, Ithar cannot brace, the Ithar fade after firing (AI and bot), against Chorus feed and bite regrowth; the attune verb

s28.note: Deathless endless legion on both sides (6+ hulls: two returns, the waken verb adds one), travelling torpedoes against a Deathless line, Corsair rockets into point defense

s29.note: The Nemesis (stream B step 2): a Hegemony elite fleet with weaknesses flank and anchor (escorts flee under 60%), adaptations armor and point defense, one scar; torpedoes, lances and the new boons (Slip the Net, Spread Pattern, Marked for Death, Shield Wall, Chain Lightning, One Clean Line)

s30.note: The Nemesis with the other weaknesses (ion, torp, board, slow, brawl) and adaptations (shields, evasion, aim) on a Chorus fleet; Ashgrove carriers with wing stances (strike, screen, hunt), Brood Tithe, The Endless Swarm, screening wings against torpedoes

s31.note: Classic mode with travelling torpedoes on both sides (turnStart order), Hegemony sync for the enemy, the Voidsworn brace cover

s32.note: Dead-star tidal death (X20 verifier): sector 1 Corsair raiders on a dead-star field with the basic bot; a ship ends a turn on the well's rim and is torn apart by tidal stress (wellTick killCause tidal, queued death at the turn tick)

s33.note: Rift board (X20 verifier): a jagged chasm splits the field, crossed by two or three bridges (VOID.rift, riftCells as board cut-outs); Ithar in an asteroid belt, the full bot

s34.note: Shoals board (X20 verifier): holes torn out of the middle of the field (cut and inner cells, noise-edged); Chorus on an open field, the full bot

s35.note: Nemesis R42/R49, Corsair (stream B step 4): raid faction riches (two escapes plus the riches special bring extra ships at the edge), greedy persona (+25 on your flagship), boarders and rockets traits, the 'remember' memory line; he withdraws when his flagship drops under 35% hull (nemFleeCheck, flee_battle signature); flank and brawl weaknesses found by triggering them

s36.note: Nemesis R42/R49, Ithar: the duel fleet (four hulls at most, all elite), honed 2 (aim +6, shields x1.2), riches ignored for a non-raid faction, shielded and artillery traits, veil special, faction AI (keep range 3, pick off the weakest), duel signature; withdraws once every flagship shield is down and hull under 60%; ion and torp weaknesses found

s37.note: Nemesis R42/R49, Voidsworn: the challenge (nemDuelTarget: your flagship, then your biggest ship once it falls, logged), +20% damage both ways in the duel, his flagship hunts it (+30 target bonus) and charges (tw x.7), zeal trait (+12% at 1 hex) and zeal special, veterans, never routs; slow weakness found at round 2

s38.note: Nemesis R42/R49, Hegemony: artillery line (escorts' guns opt +1, syncPull x2), formation special (enemy sync radius 4), artillery and gunnery traits, the gloat line, campaign reinforcements (reinforce signature), line signature; anchor and flank weaknesses found

s39.note: Nemesis R42/R49, Deathless: undying trait and legion special (two more returns), regrowth trait, never routs (revive faction), cruel persona (finishes crippled ships), the 'again' line when his adaptation counters what beat him (lance and shields; here armor and legion, so 'remember'); slow weakness found

s40.note: Nemesis R42/R49, Chorus: fed 3 (hull x1.12 incl. sections), hunger special (+3 regen), brood (one more wing and spare) and swift traits, ravenous persona, 'It' pronoun in the log; board weakness found

s41.note: Config type safety on the dead-star board (takeover queue item 3): cfg.alt arrives as a Dictionary (a settings blob) instead of a bool. The game reads cfg.alt!==false, so anything but false means alternating activations; battle_api.gd once compared it with == false, which stops the call in GDScript (the same bug stopped battle.gd:438 on the dead-star board). Generated sector 2 Hegemony fleet, full bot, an ion storm field, gravity well pulls and tidal damage

s42.note: Stream B step 5 admiral band: Fleet Marshal Reyes (squadrons +10% now, was +25%; +1 wing, squadron hull +25%) with his Hegemony strike group start fleet plus a dominion, against a generated Corsair swarm; his Launch the strike group Command

s43.note: Stream B step 5 admiral band: the Matriarch of Nine Throats with her new start fleet (brood and two drones), Chorus spore swarms and the Spawning surge Command, against Ithar; the Mending Choir and Nekhet 4% regrowth is covered by s15 and s28

s44.note: Stream B step 6, R41 arc hull variants as sidegrades: the Gilded marauder (two prow torpedoes, no hull bonus) in your Corsair fleet against the Jackal court guard (turreted gauss and a gauss sentry, no hull bonus) in a Deathless fleet

s45.note: Stream B step 6: the Sun-eater razorfiend (bio-plasma turret and prow spitter, regrows 11) in your Chorus brood against the Archive wraithcarrier (pulsar lance and turret, three wings, shields 24, speed 3) in an Ithar fleet

s46.note: Stream B step 6: the unchanged arc rows, the Voidsworn lance penitent in your fleet against the Hegemony interdictor variant (ion prow, turbo turret)
